### Wisdom from the Psalms 7/25
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-7-or-25-552468.html
Passage: Psalm 93:1
Points:
- God is portrayed like a victorious commander who inspires total confidence before the battle begins.
- The Lord is the supreme source of power, strength, and unmatched wisdom.
- In daily personal struggles, believers can remember that God leads the way and never retreats.
- Trusting and taking refuge in the Lord replaces fear with praise.

### God's Eternal Reign
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-eternal-reign
Passage: Psalm 93:1-5
Points:
- Creation and redeemed believers both exist to display and celebrate God's sovereign majesty.
- Unlike ancient mythological depictions of chaos, God has no rivals and holds absolute control over the universe.
- The Lord exercises His righteous rule over His people through His trustworthy commandments.
- The church's holiness and obedience serve as a vital witness of God's reign to the surrounding world.
